independent_math_reference.meaning: Reference arithmetic only; its [0,width) sample domain differs from frozen candidate and is not claimed as candidate coverage.

nonblockers.detail: Contract continuous native domain <=639/479 excludes fractional border strip admitted by previous reference [0,width). Native coordinates(639.2,100)/(200,479.2) and source576(575,575) are deliberately SOURCE_OUTSIDE although rounded address may exist. Target in-FOV uses<=575. This rule is frozen and retained, not silently treated as reference-equivalent.

Associated depth is17.126ms later and assigned on unrounded RGB feature ray with nearest-neighbour local-constant approximation. No target depth or visibility truth, no distortion/temporal compensation. Supports conditional descriptive consistency only.

Some divisions assume M>0; applicable because all frozen S80 rows have nonempty accepted sets. This is not a generic empty-row runner; changed inputs would require a new contract. Shared-source empty intersections are represented without fabricated scores.

ALL_RECORDS.csv target_id means target feature index, not frame20-23; row_id identifies target frame/arm/matcher. Paired JSON explicitly names target_feature_id. Use row_id for joins and describe this in readout.

execution_boundary: Root may invoke the exact reviewed source/contract once under60s budget in unique execution_01; no permission for automatic retries, tuning, new matching or generation. Real output acceptance belongs to later independent saved-data review.
